description: This file contains Go source code that implements HTML translation within Markdown documents using the Goldmark library. It parses Markdown, identifies HTML blocks, and translates the HTML content with context-aware handling of HTML tags to avoid translating code, pre, script, and style blocks.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlocks
methods.description: Main function that processes a Markdown string to translate embedded HTML blocks from source to target language.

methods.name: htmlBlockSpan
methods.description: Determines the start and stop positions of an HTML block within the source document.

methods.name: applyHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Applies a series of HTML replacements to the original body string.

methods.name: sortHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Sorts HTML replacements by their start position for correct application order.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlock
methods.description: Translates the inner content of an HTML block, avoiding translation within certain tags.

methods.name: shouldTranslateHTMLText
methods.description: Determines whether a text node within HTML should be translated based on skip depth and whitespace.

methods.name: isSkipTag
methods.description: Checks if an HTML tag is one that should be skipped during translation (like 'code', 'pre', etc.).
